chapter.verse: Topa ’ khut sungah kumpipa om a, lo sunga tui lak bangin a deihna peuhah hei kawikawi thei hi.
Na gamtatna khempeuh nangmah in man na sak hangin, Topa in na lungsim tawng a et telna phawk in.
Topa in biakpiakna sangin, thuman thutang deihzaw hi.
Kihisak-a gamtatna leh kiphatsakna lungsimte in, mawhna hi a, migilo hihna lim ahi hi.
Lim takin ngaihsunin geelna in hauhna lampi hi a, nawhsa-in lopthop hihna in zawn’na lampi ahi hi.
Zuau genna tawh hauhna in beimang pak a, sihna khuk sung hong tun’pih hi.
Migilote, a manin gamta nuam lo uh ahih manin, amau’ gamtat siatna mah awkpih uh hi.
Mimawhte thukawi-in gamta uh a, midikte a man-in gamta uh hi.
Phun bek a thei zi tawh inn sungah teen’ khop sangin, innkhumzang kiu khat-a tang teen’ hoihzaw tham hi.
Migilote in thusia bekbek deih uh a, a lawmte nangawn zah tuan lo uh hi.
Mi kiphasakte daan a kipiak ciangin mi mawkmawkte in pil lawh a, mipilte a kihilh ciangin thutheihna-in nei uh hi.
Midik in migilopa’ inn sung encik a, migilote lawnthalin siasak hi.
Mizawngte’ huh ngetna a pia nuam lote pen, amau zong cimawhin huhna a nget ciangun kipia lo ding hi.
A simtham-a letsong piakna in hehna dam sak a, puan nuai-a tawi in sinsona dai sak hi.
Thutangin na a kisep ciangin midik khempeuh lungdam a, ahi zongin migilote lungkham hi.
A kilawm gamtatna panin a pialkhiate, misi honte’ lakah tung hi.
A noptat nuamte zawng a, zu ne a, sathau namtui nilhte hau lo hi.
Midikte’ thuak dingin a bawlsak uh gimnate pen, migilote mah in lehthuak zawsop uh hi.
A phun hat zi gilo tawh teen’ khop sangin, gam simtham-a khat guak teen’ hoihzaw hi.
Mipilpa’ inn sungah neih leh lam a dim a ha-in om a, ahi zongin mihaipa in a ngah zahzah zangkhia pah hi.
Thuman thutakin gamta tawntung lecin, na khan’ sau-in, pahtawina na ngah ding hi.
Mipil khat in mi thahatte’ hut khuapi la zo a, amau’ muanmuan kulhpi nangawn susia zo hi.
Kampau a ki-ip zote, lungkhamna tawh kipelh hi.
Mi kihisak i cihte pen, kiliansakin a kiphasak mite ahi hi.
Mi thadahpa in na sem nuam lo ahih manin, amahmah a kithat tawm ahi hi.
Mihoih lote in lungkim hun nei loin deih thuah tawntung a, mihoihte cingh-in, piakhia tawntung uh hi.
Topa in migilote’ biakpiakna deih lo hi; ngimna hoih lo tawh a piakte uh deih lo kanlai hi.
A manlo tecite mangthang ding a, thuman tecite’ kam kiza za ding hi.
Migilote in mi’ muan theih nadingin khauh pau uh a, midikte ahih leh lungmuangin kampau hiathiat uh hi.
Pilna, theihna, thugennate in, Topa ’ mai-ah bangmah man lo hi.
Galdo nadingin sakolte a baihsa-in kikoih a, ahi zongin galzawhna pen Topa ’ hang hizaw hi.
